_comment: DDI-CDI -> CDIF Discovery profile UML. Aligned to metadataBuildingBlocks/_sources/profiles/cdifProfile/cdifDiscovery/schema.yaml. The schema is a tight set of discovery extension properties (measurementTechnique / variableMeasured / spatialCoverage / temporalCoverage / hasQualityMeasurement) with $refs out to schemaorgProperties + qualityProperties for the value types. This UML config matches that shape: no composes (cdifCore is composed in BY THE COMPOSITE profile, not by this module), and the value-type classes (VariableMeasured / SpatialExtent / TemporalExtent / QualityMeasure) are restated locally because schemaorgProperties / qualityProperties don't have their own UML configs in build-docs.ps1. Anchor stubs (Dataset, CatalogRecord, DefinedTerm) provide attachment points; cross-profile registry links DefinedTerm to CDIFCore.

targetModel.modelTitle: UML Model for the CDIF Discovery Profile
targetModel.subTitle: Discovery extension properties: measurement technique, variable measured, spatial / temporal coverage, quality measurement
targetModel.definition: CDIF Discovery profile module - the discovery-oriented extension properties added on top of a cdifCore Dataset: schema:measurementTechnique (string or DefinedTerm), schema:variableMeasured (VariableMeasured / PropertyValue), schema:spatialCoverage (SpatialExtent / Place), schema:temporalCoverage (TemporalExtent), dqv:hasQualityMeasurement (QualityMeasure). The catalog record (schema:subjectOf > CatalogRecord) MUST declare conformance to https://w3id.org/cdif/discovery/1.0.
targetModel.mainPackageDefinition: Discovery extension properties for a CDIF Dataset.

package.name: Classes
package.definition: Discovery-specific value classes: VariableMeasured (schema:PropertyValue), SpatialExtent (schema:Place), TemporalExtent, QualityMeasure.

package.name: Anchors
package.definition: Stub re-declarations of CDIFCore classes this profile attaches to. Full definitions live in CDIFCore; these stubs let the standalone discovery diagram render attachment edges without dragging in the full CDIFCore graph.

class._comment: Dataset stub - the host node the discovery properties attach to. Full definition in CDIFCore.
class.definition: Stub of schema:Dataset (full definition in CDIFCore). The discovery profile adds measurementTechnique / variableMeasured / spatialCoverage / temporalCoverage / hasQualityMeasurement to this Dataset.

class._comment: CatalogRecord stub - the metadata-about-this-resource node carried at schema:subjectOf on the Dataset. For the discovery profile, dcterms:conformsTo MUST include https://w3id.org/cdif/discovery/1.0.
class.definition: Stub of CDIFCore::CatalogRecord. For the discovery profile, dcterms:conformsTo MUST include https://w3id.org/cdif/discovery/1.0.

attribute.name: conformsTo
attribute.definition: dcterms:conformsTo - MUST include the constant https://w3id.org/cdif/discovery/1.0 for the discovery profile.

class._comment: DefinedTerm stub - cdifCore::DefinedTerm. Used by schema:measurementTechnique and by VariableMeasured / SpatialExtent attributes that can be either a string or a controlled-vocabulary term. Cross-profile registry links to /CDIFCore/Classes/DefinedTerm.html.
class.definition: Stub of CDIFCore::DefinedTerm - a schema.org DefinedTerm typically backed by a SKOS Concept. Used here as the controlled-vocabulary alternative to plain strings on measurementTechnique etc.

class._comment: VariableMeasured - the schema:PropertyValue form of a variable described by the dataset. cdifDiscovery's lightweight variable shape (cdifDataDescription adds cdi:InstanceVariable richness on top).
class.definition: A measured variable described as a schema:PropertyValue. The lightweight discovery-level shape: name, description, optional measurement technique. Richer per-variable structure (physical data types, value domains, ...) is added by cdifDataDescription.

attribute.name: name
attribute.definition: schema:name - label associated with the variable in the dataset.

attribute.name: description
attribute.definition: schema:description - free-text description of what the variable measures.

attribute.name: alternateName
attribute.definition: schema:alternateName - additional human-readable name(s) for the variable.

class._comment: SpatialExtent - schema:Place. Geographic extent of the resource content; backed by GeoSPARQL geometry when present (modelled elsewhere; not detailed here).
class.definition: Geographic extent of the resource content (schema:Place). Carries a place name, optional identifier, and optional geometry (geosparql:hasGeometry).

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id / schema:identifier - URI for this place (e.g. ROR identifier, gazetteer entry).

attribute.name: name
attribute.definition: schema:name - place name. May also be a DefinedTerm from a gazetteer.

class._comment: TemporalExtent - temporal extent of resource content. Carries start / end / a time interval string.
class.definition: Temporal extent of resource content - the period of time the resource covers.

class._comment: QualityMeasure - W3C DQV quality measurement reported for the resource. Each entry pairs a metric with a measured value.
class.definition: A W3C DQV (Data Quality Vocabulary) quality measurement: a measured value for a defined quality metric.

attribute.name: metric
attribute.definition: dqv:isMeasurementOf - URI of the dqv:Metric being measured.

attribute.name: value
attribute.definition: dqv:value - the measured value (string for generality; concrete type varies by metric).

association._comment: Dataset -> CatalogRecord via schema:subjectOf. Attachment point for the cdif:discovery/1.0 conformance declaration.
association.definition: schema:subjectOf - the catalog record describing this dataset's metadata. For the discovery profile, the CatalogRecord MUST declare conformance to https://w3id.org/cdif/discovery/1.0.

association._comment: Dataset -> DefinedTerm via schema:measurementTechnique (or plain string; UML shows the typed branch).
association.definition: schema:measurementTechnique - technique / technology / methodology used. May be a plain string or a DefinedTerm reference (this edge models the DefinedTerm branch).
schema:variableMeasured - the variables described by this dataset.
schema:spatialCoverage - geographic extent of the dataset's content.
schema:temporalCoverage - period of time the dataset covers.
dqv:hasQualityMeasurement - quality measurements reported about the dataset.

association._comment: VariableMeasured -> DefinedTerm via schema:measurementTechnique (per-variable measurement technique).
association.definition: schema:measurementTechnique - measurement technique for this specific variable.
